rounds.q: How many years old is the average car, SUV or pickup on US roads?
rounds.why: It's 12.8 years for all cars and light trucks, and regular cars alone average 14.5 years.
rounds.src: S&P Global Mobility, US vehicle age study (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Regular cars average 14.5 years old. That's a lot of birthdays for one car!

rounds.q: What % of US households have no car, truck or van at all?
rounds.why: About 8.5% of homes have no vehicle, while 22% have three or more.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year, table B08201 (2024 data)
rounds.fun: Only 8.5% go car-free, but 22% have three or more. Somebody needs a bigger driveway!

rounds.q: On average, how many miles per gallon does a new US vehicle get?
rounds.why: The 2024 average of 27.2 mpg is a record, and truck SUVs now make up half of all new vehicles.
rounds.src: US EPA, Automotive Trends Report (model year 2024 data)
rounds.fun: 27.2 miles per gallon is a brand new record. Way to go, cars!

rounds.q: How many miles does the average US driver drive each day?
rounds.why: Those 31.1 miles take about an hour (60.4 minutes) spread over 2.44 trips.
rounds.src: AAA Foundation for Traffic Safety, American Driving Survey (2024 data)
rounds.fun: About an hour behind the wheel every day. That's a lot of sing-along time!

rounds.q: How many miles long is the whole US Interstate highway system?
rounds.why: It's a tiny slice of the 4.2 million miles of US public roads, yet carries 26% of all travel.
rounds.src: US Federal Highway Administration, Our Nation's Highways (2024 data)
rounds.fun: A small slice of the roads, but 26% of all the travel. Busy, busy highways!
